description: Source code implementing a dictionary (hash or linked list based) data structure with functions for creation, deletion, insertion, search, and deletion of nodes, along with licensing and author information.

methods.name: dictNewDict
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new dictionary structure with custom comparison function and memory allocator.

methods.name: dictDeleteDict
methods.description: Deletes and frees the memory associated with a dictionary.

methods.name: dictInsertBefore
methods.description: Inserts a new node with a specified key before a given node in the dictionary.

methods.name: dictDelete
methods.description: Removes a node from the dictionary and frees its memory.

methods.name: dictSearch
methods.description: Searches for a node with a specified key in the dictionary.
